verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a per-endpoint API reference: Check Feature Gates (statsig-docs-49) and Log Custom Events (statsig-docs-50) have their own pages, alongside the HTTP API (statsig-docs-10) and Console API (statsig-docs-11). Nothing in the evidence shows that this reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the probe for a public OpenAPI spec returned 404 at every candidate path (statsig-docs-2 / statsig-probe-2). Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
